scope: historical engineering pilot; not a publication-grade held-out benchmark

defaults.privacy: no student or personal data recorded

limitations: The repository does not contain per-sample reference proofs or trustworthy-source citations.
The repository has no top-level license, so redistribution rights cannot be inferred.
Pre-injection proofs, injector identities, and non-injector diff reviews were not archived.
Qualification, calibration, and strict blind-isolation evidence cannot be reconstructed after the fact.
The 50-item pilot has already been exposed to engineering evaluation and is not a held-out test set.
The frozen source rows contain ordered step text but no source spans, dependency edges, or node-level verdict gold.
No publication train/dev/test assignment exists; only the dataset-level engineering-pilot scope is honest.
Variable-normalized similarity is a conservative first-pass heuristic, not a semantic duplicate proof.
